parameters.name: command
parameters.description: command to execute on remote host. (templated)

parameters.name: powershell
parameters.description: powershell to execute on remote host. (templated)

parameters.name: cmdlet
parameters.description: cmdlet to execute on remote host (templated). Also used as the default value for `task_id`.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: When using the `cmdlet` or `powershell` option, use `arguments` to provide arguments (templated).

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: When using the `cmdlet` or `powershell` option, use `parameters` to provide parameters (templated). Note that a parameter with a value of `None` becomes an *argument* (i.e., switch).

parameters.name: logging_level
parameters.description: Logging level for message streams which are received during remote execution. The default is to include all messages in the task log.

parameters.name: runspace_options
parameters.description: optional dictionary which is passed when creating the runspace pool. See

parameters.name: wsman_options
parameters.description: optional dictionary which is passed when creating the `WSMan` client. See

parameters.name: psrp_session_init
parameters.description: Optional command which will be added to the pipeline when a new PowerShell session has been established, prior to invoking the action specified using the `cmdlet`, `command`, or `powershell` parameters.

parameters.name: psrp_conn_id
parameters.description: Required. The name of the PSRP connection.

parameters.name: logging_level
parameters.description: Logging level for message streams which are received during remote execution. The default is to include all messages in the task log.

parameters.name: operation_timeout
parameters.description: Override the default WSMan timeout when polling the pipeline.

parameters.name: runspace_options
parameters.description: Optional dictionary which is passed when creating the runspace pool. See

parameters.name: wsman_options
parameters.description: Optional dictionary which is passed when creating the `WSMan` client. See

parameters.name: on_output_callback
parameters.description: Optional callback function to be called whenever an output response item is received during job status polling.

parameters.name: exchange_keys
parameters.description: If true (default), automatically initiate a session key exchange when the hook is used as a context manager.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Optional PowerShell host instance. If this is not set, the default implementation will be used. You can provide an alternative `configuration_name` using either `runspace_options` or by setting this key as the extra fields of your connection.
